scope: Observed additional Loft BRep endpoint orders: Free edge start, Free face end, Tangent/Smooth edge end, and two distinct tangent edges. No exact topology/geometry reconstruction.

integration.dispatcher: Append standalone helper to public Loft readers; helper imports existing strict sources and modes only, never public decode_loft.
integration.expected_settings: Each samples[].expected_settings is the complete helper-returned dictionary for exact main-entrypoint equality.
integration.shared_changes: None. Existing section_resolver and allow_edge_end_conditions modes hooks are reused unchanged.
integration.source_reuse: Profile/face/flag1 edge sections delegate to resolve_loft_face_section. New flag0 edge section reader independently enforces same typed276-byte topology/recipe/context/anchor/owner framing; it does not alter generic source acceptance.

native_evidence.endpoint_conditions: Stored Free0, Tangent1, Smooth2 controls frame as before. Active weights bind exact Start Weight/End Weight roles; explicit Start1.3/End1.7 distinguish two-edge field ownership.
native_evidence.edge_descriptor_flag: Captured first edges from cylinder endFaces use raw byte3=1; captured last edges from cylinder startFaces use0. Reader guards these observed combinations; position and source topology both change, so flag semantics are not identified.
native_evidence.body_ownership: Source edge/face descriptors point to typed historical body anchors. In both-edge case native bodies and source-owner features are distinct; API custom names independently identify StartCylinderBody and EndCylinderBody.
native_evidence.alignment: Actual API start/end alignment enums0 in these samples. No native alignment contrast: production values remain null with explicit status.

findings: Five captures exported with zero case/getter errors. Documented single-edge Path inputs normalize to actual API BRepEdge sections; direct BRepEdge section input was not used.
Free edge start and Free face end succeed independently of weighted edge cases.
End Tangent1.5 and End Smooth1.25 match their native codes and End Weight binding. Both Tangent weights1.3/1.7 independently match Start/End controls.
Exact circular edge/planar face identity and geometry remain opaque topology recipes; native design body IDs are not ASM indices.
Previously supported first-face/first-weighted-edge variants stay in the earlier strict reader; this helper admits only its five observed configurations.
limitations: Only open solid NewBody/two sections/no guides. Captured combinations are enforced; both Smooth, mixed face/edge sources and other operations remain unverified.
Raw descriptor flag meaning, exact face/edge recipe-to-ASM topology, contextual transforms, trim reconstruction and alignment encoding unresolved.
Kernel regeneration, persistent result lifecycle mapping, native writer and general BRep loft reconstruction remain unavailable.
API tokens/tempIds retained only in original capture evidence, never matched as native IDs; API default body names are not inferred from empty native labels.
